summary: The filing is a Form 6-K containing a press release from TRX Gold Corporation reporting its Q3 2026 financial results. It covers operational highlights such as record throughput, gold production of 7,426 ounces, revenue of $32.9 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $20.7 million. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The release is a routine quarterly earnings report and does not constitute a special situation event.
